name: kdtree_gpu
_comment: GPU-native twin of kdtree_default, for the batched-throughput arm. Two things differ from the CPU default and both are forced by the CUDA builder, not by taste: axisPolicy is center_longest_axis because median_longest_axis is classified unsupported_policy and would silently fall back to a CPU measurement wearing a GPU label (SchemaSearch.cpp gpuSupportStatusForSchema), and this schema must be run with --cuda-builder kdtree rather than the default mixed builder, because MixedTree caps maxDepth at 12 while the KDTree builder allows 22 and, more importantly, MixedTree serves kNN with a brute-force full-cloud scan that does not return neighbours at all. Depth and leaf capacity are held identical to kdtree_default so the two backends are answering with the same tree shape.
